items.stem:
Assertion (A): A trademark is a legally protected brand.
Reason (R): Every brand name is automatically a trademark.
Choose the correct option.
items.answer: A is true, but R is false.
items.markingKey: (c) A is true; R is false: a brand becomes a trademark only on registration.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

items.stem: A clinic lets patients book appointments online and get reports by e-mail. Which element of the marketing mix is involved?
items.answer: Process
items.markingKey: (d) Process. It is the way the service is delivered.

items.stem: Distinguish between price skimming and penetration pricing on the basis of suitable when, later price and aim.
items.answer: (i) Suitable when: price skimming: the product is new and unique with few rivals; penetration pricing: demand is price-sensitive and rivals are many. (ii) Later price: price skimming: lowered over time; penetration pricing: may be raised once customers are won. (iii) Aim: price skimming: to earn high profit from early buyers; penetration pricing: to capture market share quickly.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each basis: (i) Suitable when: price skimming: the product is new and unique with few rivals; penetration pricing: demand is price-sensitive and rivals are many. (ii) Later price: price skimming: lowered over time; penetration pricing: may be raised once customers are won. (iii) Aim: price skimming: to earn high profit from early buyers; penetration pricing: to capture market share quickly.

items.stem: Nair Retail distributes leaflets in Mysuru to tell people about its new tuition centre. Which goal of marketing is being pursued?
items.answer: Creating awareness
items.markingKey: (b) Creating awareness. People are told about the service.

items.stem: Which term is described here? "A brand or part of a brand that is registered and legally protected."
items.answer: Trademark
items.markingKey: (c) Trademark: A brand or part of a brand that is registered and legally protected.

items.stem:
Vihaan has started making handmade chocolates in Agra with no added sugar. He has named them 'PureBite', packs them in recyclable boxes, and prints ingredients, net weight and expiry date on each box.
(i) What is the USP of PureBite? (ii) State two benefits of branding to Vihaan. (iii) State two functions of the label.
items.answer: (i) Chocolates with no added sugar (also eco-friendly packing). (ii) Product differentiation; customer loyalty; premium pricing; ease of introducing new products (any two). (iii) Gives information about contents; tells the expiry date; identifies the product (any two).
